title: See Seville in Comfort
text: This was well worth it and Emilio was a great guide. A very relaxed way to see Seville Centre when the weather was hot and very humid. Highly recommend.
author: jabontour2016

title: Nice to consider for Seville
text:
Nice for taking a nice tour of the city and getting a primer on things to do with a bit of a breeze that saves you from the heat of Seville.
Actually, we did not have the guide in Italian as per the reservation, but with Spanish and a bit of English, our super guide Donald saved the review. We enjoyed it a lot. Recommended? Of course it is.
author: Paola_O

title: Great value for money Excellent tour guide
text:
Emilio our driver was excellent on our tour of beautiful Seville 

He was very knowledgeable of the City...
Clear communication to us all on the trip 

However the company does need to update their link to the meeting point as the confirmation email had the link to the other office which was 20min walk away... but they did arrange for our fabulous driver to come to our location to start the tour... 
Please update your information on the link
author: 430octaviak
